objective: Audit how the ledger rounds money, converts currencies and checks permissions, without changing it.
acceptance: Report rounding, conversion and permission risks with the affected paths

reference.findings: ledger/rounding.py: scale() multiplies by a binary float and rounds half to even, so tax and discounts computed with it are not rounded half up. ledger/fx.py: convert() rounds twice through scale(), assumes two decimal places for every currency and accepts a rate of zero. ledger/permissions.py: allowed() gives an unknown role the clerk's permissions, so a misspelt role may post entries.
